[[Elsnil Frigidheart]] is an [[elementalist]] [[boss]] that travels with a roving pack of [[Frozen Elemental]]s. Caution should be taken not to [[aggro]] several groups.

==Locations==
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Ice Cliff Chasms}}

16 [[Water Magic]]
* {{skill icon|Blurred Vision}}
* {{skill icon|Deep Freeze}}
* {{skill icon|Glyph of Lesser Energy}}
* {{skill icon|Ice Spikes}}
* {{skill icon|Water Attunement}}
* {{skill icon|Water Trident}} ([[elite]])

==Items dropped==
* [[Elsnil's Frigidheart]] ([[unique]])
* [[Pile of Elemental Dust]]

==Trivia==
* This boss is named after [[Linsey Murdock]]. Elsnil is ''Linsle'' backwards, the latter being Linsey's nickname.
